name: VASCO Project
summary: Vanishing and Appearing Sources during a Century of Observations (VASCO), an astronomy research effort using historical and modern sky-survey data to investigate disappearing, appearing and transient sources, including possible technosignature candidates.

relationships.context: The disputed analyses use digitized scans of historical Palomar Observatory Sky Survey photographic plates.
